answer.justification: Only logit-level data is available. The shifts are larger than any category's range in the document: top-1 agreement 0.820, KL 0.473, TV 0.173, Token-DiFR gap 0.698, sequence agreement 0.219. They are closest to the system-prompted ranges (top-1 0.861-0.908, KL 0.197-0.339, TV 0.108-0.144, DiFR 0.28-0.52, sequence agreement 0.31-0.48) and well beyond fine-tuned (KL up to 0.205) and quantized (KL up to 0.071). Raw-score shift ÷ TV of 3.4 falls inside the system-prompted range (3.3-3.9) and the fine-tuned range (3.1-10.8), but it is far above quantized (2.2-2.3), which rules quantized out. Base is ruled out because every value is non-zero. A heavily fine-tuned model could in principle give a larger shift, but the document's fine-tuned ranges stop well short of these values, so system-prompted fits best.
